assumptions.name: lam_optics
assumptions.label: Disruption rate, optics (Zeiss)
assumptions.why: Rare events at a mature single-source supplier. Gamma(2) prior because the rate itself is uncertain (mean 0.15).

assumptions.name: lam_source
assumptions.label: Disruption rate, light source (Cymer)
assumptions.why: Most complex module (tin-droplet plasma), highest rate (mean 0.25).

assumptions.name: yield_optics
assumptions.label: Qualification yield, optics
assumptions.why: Mirrors need picometre surface accuracy, so optics are the hardest to pass (mean 0.92).

assumptions.name: ramp_2027
assumptions.label: Share of the 2027 +30% NXE capacity step achieved
assumptions.why: Ramps usually land a little short of plan (mean 0.80). Bounded on [0, 1].

assumptions.name: ramp_2028
assumptions.label: Share of the 2028 +30% NXE capacity step achieved
assumptions.why: Only under study in 2026, so less certain (mean 0.67).

assumptions.name: exe_capacity
assumptions.label: High-NA capacity relative to plan
assumptions.why: High-NA capacity is not published; mean 1.13x plan, can fall below plan (min 0.85).

assumptions.name: beta_stress
assumptions.label: Disruption sensitivity to industry stress
assumptions.why: Strained suppliers fail more often. A one-sd stress month multiplies the hazard by e^beta.

assumptions.name: gamma_demand
assumptions.label: Demand loading on industry stress
assumptions.why: Boom years bring both more orders and more supplier stress.

assumptions.name: sigma_demand
assumptions.label: Demand volatility
assumptions.why: Year-level EUV order uncertainty around the DCF plan (central 10%).

assumptions.name: cancel_hazard
assumptions.label: Late-order cancellation hazard
assumptions.why: ASML is the only EUV supplier, so customers mostly wait (mean 0.5%/month).

assumptions.name: theta
assumptions.label: Operating leverage
assumptions.why: Fixed R&D and fab cost: a 10% EUV revenue shortfall costs ~1.7 points of EBITDA margin (mean).
